selection_method: seeded sample without replacement per specialty, in spec specialty order, after excluding ALL Stage 5N and 5O source IDs (both are now development evidence)

arm_definitions.full-transcript: baseline: complete interviewer+patient transcript JSON, as Stage 5O
arm_definitions.truncation-headtail: literature baseline, deterministic (no model call): first + last K characters of the serialised transcript, K set per case so the truncated representation approximately matches that case's structured-handoff serialisation size; marker line notes the elision
arm_definitions.freetext-summary: naive-compaction baseline: one extra model call producing an unstructured free-text summary of the transcript (no schema, no provenance), passed to a fresh diagnostic context
arm_definitions.structured-handoff: ours: provenance-linked structured handoff, as Stage 5O
arm_definitions.handoff-plus-sources: ours + provenance: handoff plus cited raw patient turns, as Stage 5O

matched_across_arms: same interviewer, same 3-question budget, same coverage tool, same retriever top-k 8, same model, same answer instruction; only the diagnostic input representation changes

preregistered_primary_comparison.test: paired McNemar (exact), Wilson 95% CIs per arm, ties reported
preregistered_primary_comparison.power_note: n=100; with ~10-point expected gap McNemar power depends on the discordant-pair count, not n alone. Stage 5O observed 3 discordant pairs in 30 cases (all favouring handoff); if the discordant rate (~10%) and direction persist, ~10 discordant pairs are expected, giving informative but not high-powered inference. All other comparisons are secondary and exploratory.

dry_run_cost_estimate.basis: Stage 5O actuals: $0.33 for 209 provider calls (~$0.00158/call), gemini-2.5-flash
dry_run_cost_estimate.logical_calls: 100 cases x (~3.8 interview calls shared across arms + 5 diagnosis calls, one per arm + 1 freetext-summary call) ~= 980
dry_run_cost_estimate.note: truncation-headtail input construction is deterministic (no extra call); its diagnosis call is counted in the 5. Estimate 980 x $0.00158 ~= $1.55; upper range covers retries and longer outputs.

honesty_rules: spec frozen and committed before any paid execution
no tuning on holdout cases after seeing results; deviations require a new frozen spec
development evidence (5N/5O) stays labelled as such
